description: This is a shell script file that implements automated tests for the 'git mktag' command, which creates and verifies annotated tags in a Git repository. The script defines various test cases to validate the correctness of tag object creation, verification, and error handling, including parsing, object validation, and header checks.

methods.name: check_verify_failure
methods.description: Function to test verification failures for tag objects under different scenarios, expecting specific error messages for invalid tag data.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function to define test cases expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_expect_mktag_success
methods.description: Function to define test cases expecting successful creation of tag objects.
